api-docs.png.app_state: the API serving models/pipeline.joblib, with the compose stack up and the prediction log reachable, before any request was scored
api-docs.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
api-docs.png.data_source: none: the page is the OpenAPI schema FastAPI generates from the models
api-docs.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the five routes the page lists, and the request and response shapes a caller is validated against
api-docs.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally

api-prediction.png.app_state: the compose stack started on an empty prediction log, with the /predict operation opened in Try it out mode and executed once with the body shown
api-prediction.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
api-prediction.png.data_source: one invented applicant typed into the request body: identifier 999001, outside the range of the Home Credit identifiers, and ten round feature values chosen by hand. No value comes from the Home Credit data
api-prediction.png.demonstrates_behaviour: a request to /predict and what the caller receives: the probability, the decision, the threshold that produced it, and the model version
api-prediction.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally

drift-report.png.app_state: no service: the report is a file, opened after the run
drift-report.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
drift-report.png.data_source: the reference sample of the training population against the raw payloads of the logged requests
drift-report.png.demonstrates_behaviour: what Evidently compares and what it flags, on the traffic the replay produced
drift-report.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally
drift-report.png.url: file:// the HTML report scripts/monitoring_drift.py writes

grafana-dashboard.png.app_state: Grafana and Prometheus provisioned from infra/grafana/, scraping the API during the same replay. The summary panels count two decisions: they read counters held by the API process, and the process had restarted after most of the replay, so its counters had started again from zero
grafana-dashboard.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
grafana-dashboard.png.data_source: the Prometheus scrape of /metrics, over the minutes of the replay
grafana-dashboard.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the dashboard is provisioned by the repository, without a panel built by hand: four summary panels, predictions per second by endpoint, the median and 90th percentile of the scores beside the threshold line, and the split of decisions on either side of the threshold. The latency panel lies below the frame
grafana-dashboard.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally

prediction-log.png.app_state: the interface reading PostgreSQL after two requests from the documentation page and 240 invented applicants sent one by one to POST /predict, on a log that was empty when the stack started; the page reads the 200 most recent rows
prediction-log.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
prediction-log.png.data_source: the prediction log, which holds invented applicants only: identifiers 900001 to 900240 and 999001, outside the range of the Home Credit identifiers, with feature values drawn from a seeded random generator and rounded. No value comes from the Home Credit data
prediction-log.png.demonstrates_behaviour: what the service has been deciding: the count, the mean latency, the mean score and the refusal rate in four cards, and the most recent rows of the log
prediction-log.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally

streamlit-scoring.png.app_state: the interface of the compose stack, with the API reachable at its service address, after one click on Score this applicant
streamlit-scoring.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
streamlit-scoring.png.data_source: the example payload the page opens with, defined in credexp.app.service: three bureau scores typed by hand under the identifier 123456
streamlit-scoring.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the same request sent from a form: the returned probability, the decision and the latency, each with its caption, and the start of the full response
streamlit-scoring.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally
